selection: Select by tuning log loss; deploy LightGBM only if the paired tuning match-bootstrap 95% log-loss difference upper bound versus logistic is below zero and Brier is no worse. Otherwise logistic.
calibration_selection: Fit sigmoid on three-fold match-grouped training OOF predictions. Retain only if tuning log loss improves by at least 0.001 and Brier does not worsen. Refit base models on train+tuning, then fit retained sigmoid only on calibration.
test_policy: Freeze protocol, code hashes and fitted artifacts before reading final-test outcomes. Evaluate once; repeat CLI calls read the stored result. A new version must disclose prior test inspection.
stress_test: Use frozen five team-ID groups. For each group exclude every train, tuning and calibration match involving those teams; refit the locked serving family and its preprocessing/calibrator. Evaluate that group's chronologically held-out 2015/16 shots separately. Hyperparameter family is fixed from the primary development experiment; this is not independently retuned unseen-team selection.
test_disclosure: Premier League 2015/16 whole-date chronological holdout. All protocols frozen before evaluation; later model evaluations share the xG holdout and are not independent untouched tests.
